text_block_list.text:
Since Sirius Symboli's new racing racewear arrived,
we went out to buy matching accessories for it.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: ...Heehーー

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I'll go match it with my Racing Racewear.
Stay put and wait for me.

Sirius Symboli headed to the fitting room.
While browsing the shop in the meantime—
a certain brooch caught my eye.

A star-shaped brooch. The blue stone set in its center
shines with a dazzling brilliance,
as if ready to scorch everything in its path.
choice_data_list: (...In a way, it's just like her.)
(...It kind of reminds me of her.)

text_block_list.text: Before I knew it, I had picked up the brooch.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: I'm back.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Wait—hey, are you listening?

As I answered, something caught my eye.
The brooch on her left breast was—

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Hm?
Hey, that brooch—

After exchanging brief glances, both of us fell silent.
What we were thinking—was probably the exact same thing.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
…………
Why did you pick that up?
choice_data_list: I thought it was just like you.
I thought it was just like you.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: What made you think that?
—From the moment we met, her presence was overwhelming.

"From that point on, I learned more and more. For instance,
how thoroughly she was thinking through her own future."

That you value your own choices, and others' choices,
above all else.

"That all of those thoughts connect to a future where she stands
at the pinnacle of the world, leading to a new legend."

So the reason I thought
this brooch was just like her is—
choice_data_list: Because you're a first-magnitude star who will become a legend.
Because you're a first-magnitude star destined for legend.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
......Heh.
Not a bad answer.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: I—chose this ornament for the sake of a certain vow.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Number one: Claim the most brilliantly shining throne that lies at the end of this thorny path.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Second. To shine in this sky
as a first-magnitude star, brighter than anyone else.
choice_data_list: Then I swear I'll be there to witness that legend!
Then I swear I'll be there to witness that legend!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Haha, what a passionate proposal.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Then let us do this. From this moment forth,
our stars shall be our engagement rings.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
I swear to reach the pinnacle,
and you swear to watch over me from by my side.
...Got it?

A pair of matching star brooches. As a symbol of our vow,
I bought one of them to keep for myself.
Afterward—
Sirius Symboli mentioned wanting to buy perfume as well, so I decided to accompany her.

text_block_list.name: Perfume Shop Clerk
text_block_list.text: Just one bottle of this perfume, then?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: No, two of the same, please.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"......Huh?
...You really are slow on the uptake."

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: After picking that brooch, there's no way you're taking these separately, right?
choice_data_list: Ah, then one of them is mine...?!
Ah, then one of them is mine...?!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Don't give me any jokes about losing your wallet.
Now that you've come this far, you're seeing this through to the end with me.

I decided to have dinner at a French restaurant.
I've been studying about France lately, so I should be able to order without a hitch--!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Well now, what should I do?
choice_data_list: Apparently today's main dish is pan-seared beef tenderloin.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: ......Heheh.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Looks like you did your homework.
Good to see you're being a smart kid.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"Then I'll leave the order to you.
—Let's see if your choice can satisfy me."
We decided to head over to our usual pool hall.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: —I have an idea for today.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: You bear the very same star that I do.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Then I can't have you staying
a fragile little critter forever.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Let's make this a match with no handicaps.
Bare your fangs and sink your teeth in with everything you've got, puppy.
